cause: Virtualenv Windows python.exe is a redirector. Original supervisor sampled Popen launcher PID, not actual interpreter; kill() also targeted launcher only. Historical memory peak cannot be recovered.
correction: tools/evaluation/python_worker_monitor.py obtains token-bound real interpreter PID before worker code, samples that PID, and terminates the owned process tree. Three harmless process tests pass; no model training rerun.
limits: Do not claim the historical 6GiB limit was enforced, or that nominal compliance proves actual peak memory. Numerical outcomes remain weak synthetic research evidence and fail the quality gate.
